product_name: Motorola g57 Power 5G (Pantone Corsair, 128 GB) (8 GB RAM) | 7000 mAh Battery | 6s Gen 4 Processor | 6.72" FHD+ Display | 50MP + 8MP | 8MP Front Camera |
